checks.issue: THE TITLE AND THE BODY SPELL THE SAME WORD TWO WAYS, ON ONE PAGE. The title is printed สัมพัทเธ, with ั above the พ; every one of the three stanza-opening verses prints สัมพุทเธ, with ุ below it. Both read at 8x on isolated crops, stacked one above the other for comparison — the vowel is unambiguously above in one and below in the other. Standard Pali is Sambuddhe, so the TITLE looks like the misprint. Reproduced exactly as printed on both, which is why title_pali is Sambaddhe while every verse romanises Sambuddhe. THE ID FOLLOWS THE BODY, not the title — 'sambuddhe' — because an id is a permanent handle and should not carry a probable slip. This is the third page in four to spell one word two ways: page 72 did it with Pāṭimokkha, page 76 with sampuṇṇa.

TWO COLUMNS, AND THE GUTTER WAS MEASURED: a 140px empty band at x 1000-1140, far wider than any word space on those rows. Read ACROSS. The honest test agrees — the left column alone reads สัมพุทเธ อัฏฐะวีสัญจะ / ปัญจะสะตะสะหัสสานิ / เตสัง ธัมมัญจะ สังฆัญจะ, a stack of half-lines with no verb between them. FIRST PAIRING SHOWN FOR CHECKING: left สัมพุทเธ อัฏฐะวีสัญจะ + right ท์วาทะสัญจะ สะหัสสะเก.

อัฏฐะจัตตาฬีสะ IS ฬ, PROVEN BY COMPARISON RATHER THAN BY MAGNIFICATION. Set beside the two undoubted พ of สัพเพ three rows below it, on the same sheet in the same size, this letter plainly carries the tall ascender they lack. That is the test page 77 established and it is now the standing method for this letter.

A FULL STOP WHERE THE TWO PARALLEL LINES HAVE NONE. Verse 12 ends นะมามิ สิระสา อะหัง. with a stop; verses 2 and 7, which are the same line in the other two stanzas, end อะหัง with nothing. Read at 5x on an isolated crop. Reproduced as printed on all three. Since these three stanzas are otherwise identical apart from their numbers, this is the kind of difference worth a second look at the book.

THE LAST THREE LINES OF EACH STANZA ARE WORD FOR WORD IDENTICAL — verses 3-5, 8-10 and 13-15 are the same three lines printed three times. Not a duplication and not a paste error: the refrain is chanted after each count. Recorded because check_render walks strings in printed order and a line repeated verbatim three times is exactly the case that looks like a fault.

batch_status.notes: PAGE 78 ANSWERS PAGE 77'S OPEN QUESTION and closes two chants. Four things for Josh.
